description: This file defines interface functions and constants for managing port isolation features of the RTL8367C switch chipset. It provides function declarations for setting and getting port isolation permissions and EFID related to port isolation, facilitating hardware configuration through an API.

methods.name: rtl8367c_setAsicPortIsolationPermittedPortmask
methods.description: Sets the port mask specifying permitted ports for port isolation on a given port.

methods.name: rtl8367c_getAsicPortIsolationPermittedPortmask
methods.description: Retrieves the permitted port mask for a given port's isolation settings.

methods.name: rtl8367c_setAsicPortIsolationEfid
methods.description: Sets the EFID (Extension Feature ID) for port isolation on a specific port.

methods.name: rtl8367c_getAsicPortIsolationEfid
methods.description: Gets the EFID associated with port isolation for a specific port.
